CHAPTER.VERS: Then Bildad the Shuhite answered and said,
Dominion and fear are with him; He makes peace in his high places.
Is there any number of his armies? And on whom does not his ambush arise?
How then can common man be just with God? Or how can he be clean who is born of a woman?
Look, even the moon has no brightness, And the stars are not pure in his eyes:
How much less is common man, who is a worm! And the son of man, who is a worm!
